# EnergyEfficientNeuromorphicDesign

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design methodology that optimizes hardware and algorithmic choices to minimize energy consumption per spike and per inference, often leveraging event-driven processing. Critical for iNEST deployments where power budgets are tight, allowing continuous, real-time neuromorphic processing in distributed network environments.
